skill.name: hyperframes-media
skill.description: Guides local media preprocessing for HyperFrames projects, including narration, transcription, captions, and transparent subject overlays.
skill.summary: Prepare narration, transcripts, captions, and transparent overlays for HyperFrames compositions.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, inline command names, cache-path documentation, and a relative documentation link. The real security consideration is that the skill asks users to run local CLI, pip, and package-manager commands that may install dependencies, download models, and write media outputs.

remediation.issue: External commands are required for normal use.
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should review npx, pip, brew, and apt-get commands before running them, especially in automated agent workflows.

remediation.issue: First-run model downloads can be large and modify the user cache.
remediation.suggestion: State expected download sizes, cache locations, and cleanup steps for generated models and media outputs.

content.value_statement: Media assets often need narration, captions, and transparent subjects before composition. This skill guides local TTS, transcription, and background removal for HyperFrames projects.
actual_capabilities: Guide Kokoro-based text-to-speech narration with voice and speed selection.
Transcribe audio, video, SRT, VTT, and OpenAI response files into word timestamps.
Recommend Whisper model and language settings for accurate caption workflows.
Guide background removal for images and videos into transparent overlays.
Explain output choices for WebM, MOV, PNG, and layered HyperFrames compositions.
limitations: Requires local CLI tools and Python packages that may need separate installation.
Commands can download large models during first use.
Background-output creates a hole-cut plate, not an inpainted clean room.
Output quality depends on source media, audio clarity, and selected models.

use_cases.title: Create Product Demo Narration
use_cases.description: Generate a voiceover from a script and prepare it for a HyperFrames timeline.

use_cases.title: Build Caption Timing
use_cases.description: Transcribe speech into word-level timing data for animated captions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Presenter Overlays
use_cases.description: Remove a video background and export a transparent subject layer for composition.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic Narration
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a short voiceover.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create narration for this HyperFrames script. Recommend a voice, speed, output name, and any setup checks before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Transcribe Existing Audio
prompt_templates.scenario: Create caption timing from recorded speech.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have an audio or video file for a HyperFrames composition. Recommend the transcription model, language setting, and review steps for caption accuracy.

prompt_templates.title: Remove a Presenter Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through removing the background from a presenter video. Recommend the output format, quality setting, and how to use the result in the composition.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Full Media Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow chaining narration, transcription, and overlays.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a media preprocessing plan for a HyperFrames scene with generated narration, timed captions, and a transparent presenter. Include model choices and validation steps.

output_examples.input: A product demo needs a calm English voiceover and captions.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a suitable Kokoro voice, a natural speed, a narration file name, and a transcription pass for word timing.

output_examples.input: A Spanish customer story needs captions without translation.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a multilingual Whisper model, an explicit Spanish language setting, and review steps to preserve the original language.

output_examples.input: A presenter should appear in front of animated text.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a transparent subject layer, explains when to create a plate layer, and warns that the plate is not inpainted.

best_practices: Review all local install and CLI commands before running them.
Use multilingual Whisper models unless the audio is explicitly English.
Test generated media in the composition before final rendering.
anti_patterns: Do not use English-only transcription models for unknown or non-English audio.
Do not treat a hole-cut plate as a clean background replacement.
Do not run large model downloads without checking disk space and cache location.

faq.question: Does this skill call a hosted TTS API?
faq.answer: No. It describes local Kokoro-based text-to-speech through the HyperFrames CLI.

faq.question: Can it create word-level caption timing?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides transcription workflows that produce normalized word timing for captions.

faq.question: What happens on first run?
faq.answer: Some commands may download model files and store them under the HyperFrames cache directory.

faq.question: Can it remove a person from a room cleanly?
faq.answer: No. The background-output option creates a transparent hole, not an inpainted clean plate.

faq.question: Which video format is best for browser playback?
faq.answer: The skill recommends VP9 WebM with alpha for transparent video in browser-based compositions.

faq.question: Is this only for English media?
faq.answer: No. It includes guidance for multilingual voices and Whisper language settings.
